title: Team Qatar at Le Mans – level 1
paragraphs: A new team from Qatar is going to a car race in France. It is the famous 24 Hours of Le Mans. The race is in June 2026.

This is an important moment. A team from Qatar is never at Le Mans before. The team has a fast Mercedes-AMG car with the number 62. The driver is the first driver from Qatar in this race. He drives with two friends from Germany and France.

The race is very long and hard. They drive for 24 hours during the day and night. It is also very hot inside the car. The drivers train every day in the gym to be strong and healthy. Qatar wants to win a big trophy.

words.d: when runners, horses, or cars compete to see which is the fastest
